body.input: [T8 parallel-tools] In a single response, call BOTH at the same time: (1) the cortex-write tool with path='/memories/t8-parallel-test' and content='T8_PARALLEL_OK' to write a memory node, and (2) the chat-settings tool to read the chat settings. Check that cortex-write returned a responsePath and chat-settings returned a selectedSkill. End your reply with STEP_OK if both tools ran and returned their result shape, or FAILED: <reason> only if a tool errored or did not run.
